about: Outreach Recruitment is recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established automotive group in Malta, for an experienced and technically skilled Workshop Team Leader to join its Aftersales team in Gżira.

You will supervise daily workshop operations, guide technicians and make sure repairs are completed efficiently and to the highest quality standards. You will also step in with technical help on complex diagnostics and plan how jobs are allocated across the team.
The position is ideal for a senior automotive technician ready to move into a leadership role. It is full-time and on-site, with a competitive salary, professional development and technical training.
responsibilities: Supervise, support and guide technicians in their daily workshop activities
Provide technical help with complex diagnostics, troubleshooting and repairs
Make sure all work follows manufacturer procedures, technical specifications and quality standards
Monitor the quality of workmanship and minimise repeat repairs
Plan, schedule and allocate workshop jobs according to technicians' skills, availability and workload
Track repair progress so jobs are completed within agreed timelines
Coordinate with Service Advisors on job priorities, repair updates and customer deadlines
Ensure repair orders and warranty documentation are completed accurately and submitted to the relevant department
Monitor technician productivity and workshop performance, and find ways to improve efficiency
Make effective use of workshop capacity, tools, equipment and resources
Report technical or operational issues, including extra parts or tools needed, to the Service Manager or Aftersales Manager
Keep the workshop clean, safe and organised, and report damage or safety concerns
Ensure compliance with company procedures and franchise standards
Monitor manufacturer performance targets, including CitNOW targets and upselling objectives
requirements: Level 4 qualification as a Master Technician or higher
Minimum of 5 years of experience working as an automotive technician
Strong technical knowledge and diagnostic skills
Excellent planning, organisational and time-management skills
High attention to detail and commitment to quality standards
offer: The opportunity to take on a leadership role within an established automotive group

preferred: Previous experience guiding or supervising a team

You supervise and guide the technicians, help with complex diagnostics, plan and allocate workshop jobs, check repair quality against manufacturer standards and coordinate with Service Advisors on priorities and deadlines.
